definitions.explanation: A precious white metal used in jewelry, coins, and various applications.

examples.japanese: {銀|ぎん}の{指輪|ゆびわ}をもらった。
{銀|ぎん}メダルを{獲得|かくとく}した。

notes:
{銀|ぎん} refers to silver metal or the color silver.

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう} (bank - lit. silver house)
- {銀|ぎん}メダル (silver medal)
- {銀|ぎん}{色|いろ} (silver color)
- {銀貨|ぎんか} (silver coin)
- {銀座|ぎんざ} (Ginza - famous district)
- {水銀|すいぎん} (mercury)

METAL COMPARISON:
- {金|きん} (gold)
- {銀|ぎん} (silver)
- {銅|どう} (copper/bronze)
